name: Parkside Elementary · Praya detail pass
description: A U-shaped elementary school with two classroom wings embracing an open-sky learning court. A glazed rear circulation spine links the wings and staircase; the retained four classrooms, canteen and support rooms open toward the sheltered campus heart. September 9 successor: recessed glazing, projecting sills, connected thin blocks, framed signage and supported finishing details; original layout and identity retained.
